title: 中国AI核心产业破万：智能制造成新名片，十五五开局释放哪些机遇？
speaker: Xi Jinping

segments.en: Ladies and gentlemen, friends, this year marks the start of China's 15th five-year plan.
segments.zh: 女士们、先生们、朋友们，今年是中国第十五个五年规划的开局之年。

segments.en: It maps out China's economic and social development for the next five years and provides immense opportunities for the international community.
segments.zh: 它规划了中国未来五年的经济社会发展，为国际社会提供了巨大机遇。

segments.en: The recent years, China has embraced AI with open arms.
segments.zh: 近年来，中国张开双臂拥抱人工智能。

segments.en: We have promoted interplay between an efficient market and a well-functioning government, strengthen AI innovation, actively advanced AI class initiative and build a healthy ecosystem for all entities to thrive in together.
segments.zh: 我们推动有效市场和有为政府相结合，加强人工智能创新，积极推进人工智能+行动，构建各类主体共同繁荣的健康生态。

segments.en: The core smart economy industries are worth at least one trillion RMB yuan.
segments.zh: 核心智能经济产业规模至少达到一万亿元人民币。

segments.en: Smart devices in countless homes truly improve people's livelihood.
segments.zh: 无数家庭的智能设备切实改善了民生。

segments.en: Intelligence manufacturing in China has become another shining hallmark of Chinese modernization.
segments.zh: 中国的智能制造已成为中国现代化的又一闪亮名片。
